items.heading: Most Advice on This Topic
items.text: Most advice on this topic focuses on templates and formatting, but the real differentiator between an objective that gets read and one that gets skimmed past is specificity. A good career objective could not be copy-pasted onto someone else's resume without becoming false.

items.heading: Every Strong Career Objective Below
items.text: Every strong career objective below follows the same three-part structure, adapted to the specific person and role.

items.heading: Freshers Benefit Most From
items.text: Freshers benefit most from a career objective, since there is limited prior work experience to summarise instead. The examples below still avoid generic language by naming a specific project, internship, or skill.
